name: Immich
summary: Your own free photo backup, like Google Photos or iCloud Photos. Your photos stay on a computer you own.
gains: Feels a lot like Google Photos
Private: nothing goes to big tech
tradeoffs: You must handle backups (keep a second copy!)
Needs a computer or server with enough disk
setupSteps: Get a mini PC or server with enough disk (or use an old computer)
Install the phone app and turn on backup
Set up a second backup copy (external drive)
commercialNote: AGPL: free to use, including for business. If you modify it and let other people use it over the internet, you must publish your changes under the same license.
